name: QueueLK Mobile Application
desc: User-friendly mobile platform that allows citizens to book service tokens remotely before visiting government offices. Users can select the required service, reserve a queue position, receive notifications, and monitor their live queue status in real time. Reduces physical waiting times, minimizes overcrowding, and improves the overall public service experience.

name: QueueLK Office Admin Dashboard
desc: Designed for government office administrators to manage services, counters, officers, and daily queue operations. Administrators can monitor queue statistics, assign service counters, manage token allocations, and view performance reports through a centralized web interface.

name: QueueLK System Admin Dashboard
desc: Central management platform for the entire QueueLK ecosystem. System administrators can manage multiple government offices, configure system-wide settings, monitor platform performance, oversee user accounts, and ensure smooth operation of all connected services with advanced analytics.

name: QueueLK AI Prediction Model
desc: Intelligent component that analyzes queue data to estimate waiting times and predict service demand patterns. Using historical token records and real-time queue information, the model helps users understand expected waiting durations and assists administrators in identifying peak hours and optimizing staff allocation.

name: Help In Hand - Charity Resource Manager
desc: Web application connecting donors with charities and orphanages. Users view resource requests, make donations, and track contributions. Simplifies donor-organization communication.

name: My Quote Application
desc: Ruby on Rails web app for collecting, sharing, and managing inspirational quotes. Users create accounts, add public or private quotes, and browse others' collections with secure authentication.

name: Distributed PITRE System
desc: Three-tier distributed tax estimation system built with Python and Pyro5. Secure login and income-based tax calculation, demonstrating distributed computing concepts with SQLite.

name: Tic-Tac-Toe Flutter App
desc: 4x4 Tic-Tac-Toe mobile game developed in Flutter and Dart with a built-in AI opponent. A second-year university project to practice mobile development and basic AI logic.

name: My Personal Portfolio Website
desc: Clean and professional portfolio showcasing skills, projects, education, and achievements as a Software Engineering undergraduate. Built with modern web technologies.

name: Malware Detection Using Artificial Intelligence(Machine Learning) Approaches Implemented in Python
desc: This malware detection model was developed and tested using Google Colab, which provided a cloud-based Python environment for data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and experimentation. Google Colab enabled efficient implementation of the selected AI approach and supported the analysis of malware detection datasets

name: Guess Game
desc: Python console game where players guess a secret password from 8 words, with feedback on correct letters and positions. Practices loops, functions, and list operations.

name: Word Game in C#
desc: Console-based word guessing game in C# where players form words to earn points. Demonstrates loops, conditions, functions, and arrays while building vocabulary.

name: C++ Dictionary
desc: C++ digital English dictionary with word search, definitions, and a fun 'guess the fourth word' mini-game. Showcases file handling and data structures in C++.
